name: app-minimal-floating-nav-pill-with-cursor-tooltip-on-hatched-white
title: Floating Nav Pill with Cursor Tooltip
whatItIs: A near-white field with fine diagonal hatching and a small floating white pill of outline icons (home, folder, note-add) split by a hairline, with a black arrow cursor and a dark monospace tooltip reading 'flielist' beside it.
whatItMeans: An almost empty canvas puts all attention on the small component, and the monospace tooltip adds a technical, tool-like feel.
techniques: Tiny component isolated on an empty canvas
Soft shadow lifting a white pill from a white ground
Cursor with a dark monospace tooltip

vocabulary.definition: A small animated response to a user action.
A label that appears when the pointer rests on an item.
A background of fine diagonal lines.
